newsitem.title: USA: ITT sees Q3 shortfall due to gaming sector.
newsitem.headline: ITT sees Q3 shortfall due to gaming sector.

text.p: ITT Corp. said on Monday it expected its third quarter earnings to be "significantly" hurt by results in the company's gaming sector.
In August, revenues from the company's premium play gaming business, mostly in Las Vegas, were significantly below revenues last August, the company said in a statement.
ITT said its third quarter 1996 earnings would likely be around the same level as last year, $0.56 per share.
ITT said it had no reason to believe third quarter gaming shortfalls would be offset by improved performance in the fourth quarter.
Construction delays at the Caesars Palace casino in Las Vegas and construction disruptions at the Desert Inn casino, would have a negative impact on the third quarter, ITT said.
Increased competition in the Tunica, Mississippi casino market also "substantially" hurt the company's quarterly performance there, ITT said.
ITT said the hotel segment would have a strong performance in the third quarter and its remaining businesses were performing in-line with expectations.
The First Call mean third quarter 1996 earnings estimate was $0.82 per share and 1996 annual estimate was $2.61 per share.
